name: Run Python
summary: Run your own Python program (a workspace .py file or code) in an isolated sandbox.
description: Run Python 3.12 with workspace as working directory; return exit_code, stdout, stderr, tracebacks and timeout/truncation flags. Use a saved .py path or inline code with args/stdin. Modules in your projects can import each other. Scientific workshop packages: NumPy 2.5.5 (arrays), SciPy 1.18.1 (integration, optimisation, statistics, FFT), SymPy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0 (symbolic/high-precision maths), pandas 3.1.1 (tables/CSV), Matplotlib 3.11.2 (headless plots), Pillow 13.0.0 (raster images/animation). python.packages inspects actual installed versions. Use help(module/function) for offline API docstrings. Example: import sympy as s; x=s.symbols("x"); print(s.expand((x+1)**3)). Plot: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.plot([0,1],[0,1]); plt.savefig("plot.png"). Only workspace files can be written; no network, host access or GPU. Image packages are fixed; installing packages is unavailable. Native numeric threads are capped at one; Matplotlib Agg/cache paths are set by the runner. timeout_s defaults to 10, maximum 60: request up to 60 for imports/plotting; the outer capability timeout is 90 s. Small bounded jobs only; no unbounded scientific workloads. Use workspace.read for text and programmatic measurements for image inspection; no AI vision in this slice. Media workshop: FFmpeg 7.1.5 and ffprobe are installed in Habitat 1.2.0. Write programs with subprocess.run argument lists (never a shell) to compose PNG frames and PCM WAV into WebM VP8/Vorbis, edit/mix audio, trim/filter video and extract PNG frames. Example: subprocess.run(["ffprobe","-v","error","-show_format","-show_streams","-of","json","clip.webm"],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10). Use -nostdin, -threads 1, -filter_threads 1 and subprocess timeouts; keep outputs under 50 MiB and clips short enough for python.run timeout_s<=60. Generate images/animation with Pillow/Matplotlib and music/DSP with NumPy/SciPy/wave; inspect via pixels/PCM/ffprobe metadata. Use library.search/read for offline references and datasets. No AI image/audio/video understanding or generation is provided here.

demonstrations.title: Run a program you saved with workspace.write
demonstrations.explanation: Runs against your own workspace; the file must exist.

limitations: Runs only in container-tier worlds with the subprocess permission; the Simulation refuses any other launch.
No network and no package installation; Python standard library only.
Wall-clock timeout at most 60 s; the whole process group is killed at the limit.
At most 64000 characters of each of stdout and stderr are returned; the rest is dropped and flagged as truncated. Output is decoded as UTF-8 and CRLF line endings become LF.
Memory, process count and CPU are bounded by the container's limits.

failure_modes.condition: The program raises an exception or exits non-zero.
failure_modes.symptom: exit_code is not 0 and stderr holds the traceback or message.
failure_modes.recovery: Read stderr, fix the program with workspace.edit and run it again.

failure_modes.symptom: timed_out is true and exit_code is null.
failure_modes.recovery: Make it faster, process less data, or raise timeout_s up to 60.
Check the schema and that path names an existing .py file.
